notes: Same full126-byte UTF-8 request/N_text22, exact RU talker and codec hashes, voice kraftwerk_robot_ru_bootstrap_fidelity; reference WAV SHA-25690e5f7576991ea5b9f0a85e9109f7bd31ff667c4a12d58783a06c650796c3ca1. At step3 seed2 raw EOS logit15.804861/rank1/temp1 permitted-vocab probability0.824653654; post-sampler EOS probability0.905918617. Finite raw logits and weights, exact F32 sum/CDF/target replay choose EOS2150 correctly. EOS boost is0; guard enabled would start at79 frames (expected132, max158, force198). No upstream same-history parity was run, so model/conditioning versus native-forward calibration remains unresolved. All original payloads/package/models/corpus are unchanged.
